comments.text: They are well accustomed to the winter here; the cold does not weaken them but rather makes them stronger.

replies.author: @TheGlobalTruth04
replies.text: Absolutely! People who grow up in colder climates often adapt remarkably well to winter conditions. What feels harsh to outsiders can simply become part of everyday life for them. ❄️💪

comments.author: @AtlasDiscover1
comments.text: Seeing the raw, frozen diet is a wake-up call about what survival actually requires. It is fascinating how traditional sustenance is tailored perfectly for this brutal, icy environment.

replies.author: @TheGlobalTruth04
replies.text: Exactly. In such an extreme environment, food is far more than a preference—it’s a survival strategy shaped by generations of experience. What may seem unusual from the outside makes perfect sense when you understand the climate and the demands of daily life there.
